arc_radius.description: Ceiling on the corner arc radius (m), not the radius itself: each corner sizes its own arc from the two corridors it joins.

corner_arc_assume_wide.description: Size every corner arc as if both corridors were wide, ignoring the width belief. Identical on Obstacles (all corridors 1.0 m by rule).

dedupe_distance_m.description: Distance below which consecutive generated waypoints are treated as duplicates.

wide_center_bias_m.description: Inward shift (m) of WIDE corridor centreline waypoints; applies only to corridors above narrow_width_threshold_m.

wide_center_bias_side.description: Which boundary wide_center_bias_m shifts the path toward.

narrow_center_bias_side.description: Which boundary narrow_center_bias_m shifts the path toward; split from the wide side so narrow can hug a different boundary.

narrow_center_bias_m.description: Shift (m) of NARROW corridor centreline waypoints; 0.0 is the true centreline. Dropping it widens the narrow-to-narrow arc and eases the corner.

unconfirmed_width_inner_bias_m.description: Inner bias (m) for a narrow corridor still on the prior, not a measurement; 0.0 = inert. Shrinks the blind lap-1 width-belief step.

defer_current_corridor_replan.description: Hold a width change until the robot has LEFT the corridor it describes; Open-only by construction. Prevents moving the tracked line under the chassis.

narrow_width_threshold_m.description: Corridor width (m) at or below which the narrow bias applies; halfway between the rule widths 0.6 and 1.0. A threshold, not interpolation.

num_intermediate_arc_points.description: Number of intermediate sample points per corner arc.

straight_waypoint_count.description: Number of evenly spaced waypoints generated along a straight corridor segment.

main_loop_reached_distance_m.description: Distance (m) within which CoreNavigator's main loop counts a waypoint as reached. Deliberately separate from controller_reached_distance_m.

controller_reached_distance_m.description: Distance within which WaypointController's own internal pure-pursuit logic counts a waypoint as reached.

finish_approach_m.description: Distance (m) short of the finish line at which the robot drops to slow_mps on its last lap, to stop inside the finish section.

replan_heading_tie_margin_m.description: Distance (m) within which near-tied waypoints are re-ranked by heading agreement, not pure position, when replace_path gets the current heading.

obstacles_center_bias_m.description: Inward bias (m) applied to the Obstacles Challenge's planned path; Open passes none and uses its clearance-driven bias instead.

first_lap_corner_caution.description: Slow the approach to a previewed corner on the first lap, while the layout belief is still forming. corner_caution_all_laps extends it.

corner_caution_all_laps.description: Apply the previewed-corner speed reduction on every lap instead of only the first.

first_lap_corner_caution_narrow_only.description: Restrict the first-lap corner caution to corridors planned as NARROW.

advance_past_passed_waypoint.description: Advance the waypoint index past one already passed. Off: measured to stall the index at corners.

replan_blend_ticks.description: Ticks over which a replaced path is blended into the old one; 0 = hard switch. Refuted twice as a lever, kept configurable.

forward_only_reseek.description: Restrict path reseek to candidates ahead of the current waypoint index.
